categories.main_business_segments: Hangzhou AssureTech Biotech Co., Ltd. focuses on the research, development, production, and sales of POCT (Point of Care Testing) reagents and instruments. Its product portfolio covers eight major fields including drug abuse detection, infectious disease detection, chronic disease detection, pregnancy detection, tumor detection, myocardial detection, biochemical detection, and allergen detection. The company also explores pet health management, home health management, and medical testing laboratories as emerging business areas.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company operates nine technology platforms including antigen-antibody bioreagents, immunochromatography, dry biochemistry, chemiluminescence, precision detection, liquid biochips, microfluidics, clinical testing instruments, and biopharmaceuticals. It emphasizes proprietary antigen and antibody production technologies such as gene-engineered recombinant antigens, synthetic antigens, monoclonal and polyclonal antibodies. Manufacturing employs multi-variety, small-batch, and sales-driven production with intelligent manufacturing and SAP-enabled digital management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: AssureTech serves global customers in clinical diagnostics, forensic testing, food safety, and veterinary diagnostics. Its products are sold in over 150 countries and regions including Europe, America, Asia, and Australia. Key end markets include hospitals, third-party medical testing institutions, pharmacies, law enforcement agencies, and home users. The company also targets emerging markets in pet diagnostics and home health management.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has a global presence with subsidiaries and sales offices in China (Hangzhou, Shenzhen, Chengdu), Hong Kong, Singapore, the United States, and other regions. Its products are exported to more than 150 countries and regions worldwide, with significant sales in North America, Europe, Asia, Africa, and Oceania. It maintains a dual domestic and international market development strategy.
categories.supply_chain_position: AssureTech operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the production of diagnostic reagents and instruments. It has strategically developed upstream capabilities by producing over 70% of its core biological raw materials (antigens and antibodies) in-house, reducing reliance on imports and enhancing supply chain stability.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation and global ecosystem expansion, investing heavily in R&D with 18.69% of revenue allocated to research. It focuses on upgrading its nine technology platforms, accelerating product iteration, and expanding product matrices. Key R&D directions include chemiluminescence, precision molecular diagnostics, liquid biochips, microfluidics, and biopharmaceuticals. It also fosters industry-academia collaborations and talent development to maintain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of POCT diagnostic reagents and instruments under both ODM (Original Design Manufacturer) and OBM (Own Brand Manufacturer) models. The company sells products directly to end customers and through brand partners, with a dominant share from product sales. It also derives income from financial investments and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: AssureTech is one of the few Chinese companies capable of competing with multinational giants in the global POCT market. It holds a strong position domestically and internationally due to its integrated upstream-to-downstream product chain, extensive product portfolio, and continuous innovation. The company is recognized as a national-level specialized and innovative 'Little Giant' enterprise and has received multiple industry awards and certifications.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 540.7 million, a 7.42% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 192.3 million, up 35.85%. Total assets were about RMB 5.77 billion with a slight decrease of 0.35%, and shareholders' equity increased by 1.84% to RMB 5.2 billion. The company maintains a stable growth trajectory with significant R&D investment and expanding global market penetration.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: AssureTech emphasizes providing superior POCT products and services that meet diverse clinical and consumer needs with high sensitivity, specificity, and stability. Its competitive edge lies in its vertically integrated supply chain, proprietary core biological raw materials, advanced multi-technology platforms, and rapid product iteration capabilities. The company also focuses on global brand building, quality assurance aligned with international standards, and innovative solutions in emerging fields like pet health and home diagnostics.
